description: Google AdSense integration gotchas — ads.txt requirement and CSP directives that strict-dynamic does NOT cover

entries.title: CSP 'strict-dynamic' only covers script-src — AdSense ad iframes (frame-src) and measurement/anti-fraud beacons (connect-src) still need explicit Google hosts or ads silently fail to render/report
entries.details: A strict CSP with script-src nonce+'strict-dynamic' loads the adsbygoogle.js loader and its child scripts fine, but strict-dynamic does NOT apply to frame-src/connect-src. AdSense renders creatives in SafeFrame iframes from tpc.googlesyndication.com (+ googleads.g.doubleclick.net, www.google.com) and sends impression/click/Ad-Traffic-Quality beacons to pagead2.googlesyndication.com, googleads.g.doubleclick.net, tpc.googlesyndication.com, ep1/ep2.adtrafficquality.google, www.google.com. Omit these and ads render blank / earn nothing once traffic arrives, with no build error. Google's official guidance (support.google.com/adsense/answer/16283098) only 'supports strict CSP' and warns domain lists may break; add the stable ad hosts and keep a watch item for 'unsafe-eval'/fenced-frame errors. img-src 'https:' already covers ad images. The regex flags a frame-src directive that lacks tpc.googlesyndication.com (heuristic — verify in context).

entries.title: AdSense requires /ads.txt at the site root or it flags 'Earnings at risk' and can stop serving ads
entries.details: Placing the AdSense loader + ad units is NOT enough. The site must serve /ads.txt containing 'google.com, pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX, DIRECT, f08c47fec0942fa0' (f08c47fec0942fa0 is Google's fixed certification ID; the pub id is ADSENSE_PUBLISHER_ID without the 'ca-' prefix). On this project ads.txt lives at public/ads.txt and is served by the wrangler [assets] binding. Missing ads.txt = AdSense 'Earnings at risk — your ads.txt doesn't contain your publisher ID' and throttled/blocked ad serving.
